manifest.name: sales-playbook
manifest.description: The space's sales playbook: who the space is, what it sells, to whom, in what tone. One row per space, read and edited by the member; the AI proposes it from a site or a description but nothing is saved until the member confirms. Keyed by opaque control-plane space id.

migrations.name: create_sales_playbooks
migrations.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sales_playbooks (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  space_id TEXT UNIQUE,
  company_name TEXT,
  description TEXT,
  website TEXT,
  products TEXT,
  ideal_customer TEXT,
  tone TEXT,
  avoid_topics TEXT,
  links TEXT,
  hours TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

bootstrap.name: pg_bootstrap_sales_playbooks
bootstrap.sql:
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "accordo";

CREATE TABLE "accordo"."sales_playbooks" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  "space_id" TEXT UNIQUE,
  "company_name" TEXT,
  "description" TEXT,
  "website" TEXT,
  "products" TEXT,
  "ideal_customer" TEXT,
  "tone" TEXT,
  "avoid_topics" TEXT,
  "links" TEXT,
  "hours" TEXT,
  "created_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
